basics.name: Sidi Mohammed Kaddour
basics.label: R&D Engineer, Inria (STACK team)
basics.summary: Research and development engineer working on the edge-to-cloud continuum: application-level observability, feedback loops, and coordinated deployment of distributed systems. PhD in networks and distributed systems, with a background in machine learning for smart energy and in industrial ERP engineering.

work.name: Inria, STACK team
work.summary: CoAnsible: extending Ansible with the coordination model of Concerto for adaptive distributed deployments.
highlights: Translation of Ansible playbooks into Concerto assemblies, with automated dependency extraction
Grid'5000 provisioning tooling driven from Ansible inventories (EnOSlib)
Evaluation of coordinated reconfiguration on multi-node deployments

work.name: IMT Atlantique, STACK team
work.summary: Feedback mechanisms and application-level observability for Edge-to-Cloud applications.
highlights: Distributed video processing pipeline: motion detection at the edge, YOLO recognition in the cloud
Instrumentation with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana and distributed tracing
SLO-aware feedback loop with fault injection via Chaos Mesh, deployed on k3s over Grid'5000

work.name: Groupe Kherbouche (InterEntreprise)

work.summary: Led the ERP system of the group, from module development to production operations and team coordination.
highlights: Custom OpenERP/Odoo modules for accounting, inventory, HR and sales
Linux server and PostgreSQL administration, backups and upgrades
Requirements gathering with department heads, release and change management
